title: Stage-2 eligibility gate triplicated across mark/count/list SQL despite 'single home' view claim
evidence:
mark_followup_reminders_for_vacancy.sql:28-30:
      AND NOT has_unreminded
      AND last_stage1_at < now() - interval '2 days'
      AND (last_stage2_at IS NULL OR last_stage2_at <= last_stage1_at)
count_awaiting_for_vacancy.sql:15-17:
    WHERE NOT has_unreminded
      AND last_stage1_at < now() - interval '2 days'
      AND (last_stage2_at IS NULL OR last_stage2_at <= last_stage1_at)
list_awaiting_for_vacancy.sql:36-37:
    AND state.last_stage1_at < now() - interval '2 days'
    AND (state.last_stage2_at IS NULL OR state.last_stage2_at <= state.last_stage1_at)
The view itself exposes only inputs (20260731213000_add_inbound_email_sender_state_view.sql):
  bool_or(reminder_sent_at IS NULL) AS has_unreminded,
  max(reminder_sent_at) AS last_stage1_at,
  max(second_reminder_sent_at) AS last_stage2_at
while mark_followup_reminders_for_vacancy.sql:3 claims 'Eligibility is read from the inbound_email_sender_state view (the single home of the per-email rule)'.
detail: The view centralizes only the inputs; the 2-day cadence, restart comparison and closes_at gate are repeated in three files (stage-1's mark also still bypasses the view). A cadence change needs three synchronized edits; drift is silent.
recommended_fix: Add a stage2_due boolean to inbound_email_sender_state (join vacancy for the closes_at gate there) so mark/count/list read one column; delete the three duplicated predicates.

title: month_name gains a third private copy in email_client, with a third signature shape
detail: evidence_humanize already acknowledges duplicating audit_report's copy; this adds a third with yet another signature (String plus empty-string sentinel). A shared helper ends the drift chain.
recommended_fix: Extract one month_name into a shared server helper (e.g. domain_helpers) and have audit_report, evidence_humanize and email_client call it, adapting the three call-site error shapes.

evidence:

form_view.gleam:56 view_application_page repeats the same header/main/form/footer/snippet/form.js/apply_analytics assembly (including the eight identical form_sections.view_section_* calls listed at form_view.gleam:80-87 and form_pages.gleam:322-329).
detail: This diff mirrored body markers and the analytics script into both copies. The F1 stepper job will touch the same shell again; each mirrored edit is a drift opportunity (the copies already legitimately differ: prep block, banner).
